title: Geekvape Max100 (Aegis Max 2) 100W Kit with Z Subohm 2021 Tank Atomizer 5ml
description:
Geekvape Aegis Max 100W 21700 Kit with Zeus Subohm Tank
Max100 Kit contains a 100W box mod and a 5.5ml Z Sub Ohm Tank. Utilizing new tri-proof tech, Max100 comes with IP68-rating water & dust resistance, as well as a higher level of shock resistance, which will bring the device greater protections. Besides, with the A-LOCK design, the accidental press can be avoided, and you can prevent the inadvertent button presses from overheating your coils or your mod. Max100 Kit supports single 21700/18650 battery, and a 18650 battery adapter is included in the package. Z Sub Ohm 2021 Tank has 5.5ml capacity, features leakproof top airflow system. It supports Z0.15, Z0.2, Z0.25DC and Z0.4 ohm coil.
Features:
1. 2nd Gen of Geekvape tri-proof tech
2. 100W max output, new Aegis Max
3. New 1.1 inch full screen
4. Single 21700/18650 battery
5. Paired with 5.5ml Z Sub Ohm 2021 Tank
6. Type-C charging port with flip cover on the top
7. IP68-rating water & dust resistance, shock resistance
8. A-lock function design
9. Leakproof top airflow system
10. Enlarged filling hole & airflow for larger air inflow
11. Adopts Z0.15, Z0.2, Z0.25DC and Z0.4 ohm coil
Brand: Geekvape
Unit: 1 Set
Output Power: 5W-100W
Input Voltage: 3.2V-4.25V
Output Voltage: 0-8.5V (max 8.5V)
Minimum Voltage: 3.2V+-0.1V
Resistance Range: 0.1ohm-3.0ohm
Longest Output/Vaping Time: 10s
Temperature Control: 100C-315C(1C step-by-step), 200F-600F(5F step-by-step)
Battery: 21700/18650 (single battery, not included, replaceable)
Charging: Type-C 5V/2A
Display Screen: 1.1 inch TFT color screen
E-juice Capacity: 5.5ml
Dimension: 42.06 * 31.5 * 143.8mm
Package: Gift Box
Each set contain:
1pc GeekVape Max100 Mod
1pc GeekVape Z Sub Ohm 2021 Tank (5.5ml)
1pc GeekVape Z 0.2ohm Coil (Pre-installed, 70-80W)
1pc GeekVape Z 0.25ohm Coil (Spare, 45-57W)
1pc Coil Tool
1pc Spare Parts Pack
1pc Spare Glass Tube (5.5ml)
1pc USB Type-C Cable
1pc 18650 Battery Adapter
